product_one_liner.value: nudge provides employees with personalized financial education tailored to their circumstances, employer and workplace benefits.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes personalized financial education for employees that understands their organization and benefits. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link, the checked pricing URL produced no pricing page, and the FAQ describes bespoke pricing based on workforce, countries, term and customization. Sources: https://www.nudge-global.com/ and https://www.nudge-global.com/faq

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Dedicated client stories identify Meta and Siemens as users of nudge. Sources: https://www.nudge-global.com/clients/client-stories/meta and https://www.nudge-global.com/clients/client-stories/siemens | named_customers.0: Meta’s client story explicitly describes Meta using nudge. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/clients/client-stories/meta | named_customers.1: The client story states that Siemens chose nudge. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/clients/client-stories/siemens

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 116 employees, which falls within 101–200; profile counts may not equal exact payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/nudge-global-ltd

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists London, England as its company location; treating this as headquarters involves a minor inference. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/nudge-global-ltd | hq_country: The company profile identifies its location as London, United Kingdom; interpreting that company location as headquarters entails a minor inference. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/nudge-global-ltd

founded_year.notes: The company’s history explicitly states that nudge began in 2013. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/about

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains financial-wellbeing, benefits, client-story, research and company-news posts, rather than engineer-authored explanations of how the product is built. Source: https://nudge-global.com/resources/newsblog

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer offers product, company, legal and contact links, but no public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link; the available FAQ does not establish a multi-article documentation site. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job index lists two roles—Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer—and neither title meets the specified AI/ML/data-science criteria. Source: https://careers.nudge-global.com/jobs

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure AI, Google AI, and IBM AI Engineering
model_provider.notes: The trust page explicitly names Microsoft Azure AI, Google AI and IBM AI Engineering as enterprise-contracted APIs used for client-facing LLM services. It does not identify specific underlying model versions. Source: https://www.hello-nudge.com/platform/trust-security

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page claims ISO 27001 accreditation and operation in line with GDPR. GDPR is included as a publicly claimed compliance framework, not an independent certification. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/info-security/ | compliance_certs.0: The company explicitly claims ISO 27001 accreditation. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/info-security/ | compliance_certs.1: The page states that nudge operates in line with GDPR. This is a compliance claim rather than an independent certification. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/info-security/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The public funding profile classifies the latest deal as PE Growth, consistent with nudge’s announcement of investment from growth-equity firm Kennet Partners. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/264274-93 and https://www.hello-nudge.com/news/nudge-funding-announcement | funding_date: The latest supported investment announcement is dated March 16, 2021 and identifies funding from Kennet Partners. The month is therefore 2021-03. Source: https://www.hello-nudge.com/news/nudge-funding-announcement | funding_amount_usd: The Kennet investment announcement does not disclose an amount, and the public funding profile gates deal-specific amounts. No supported USD amount for that round was found. Sources: https://www.hello-nudge.com/news/nudge-funding-announcement and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/264274-93

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent supported funding is the Kennet growth investment announced in March 2021, before the eighteen-month window beginning May 9, 2025; no later round was identified. Sources: https://www.hello-nudge.com/news/nudge-funding-announcement and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/264274-93

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Strategic Account Executive posting accepts applications and is also listed on the current job board. Source: https://careers.nudge-global.com/jobs/8275334-strategic-account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: nudge announced personalized financial action plans powered by numa on September 1, 2026, within the requested six-month window. Source: https://www.hello-nudge.com/news/from-financial-education-to-a-personalized-financial-action-plan

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On October 15, 2026, nudge announced the appointments of Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as Vice Presidents, U.S., within the requested twelve-month window. Source: https://www.hello-nudge.com/news/nudge-appoints-debi-kesselring-and-greg-goebert-as-vice-presidents-u-s

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The published cookie documentation identifies HubSpot’s marketing platform and ZoomInfo services. These are website-visible marketing-stack signals, not proof of a particular internal CRM deployment; the cookie declaration itself has an older update date. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/privacy-policy/ | crm_stack_signal.0: The cookie table names hubspot.com and says visitor data is sent to the HubSpot marketing platform. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/privacy-policy/ | crm_stack_signal.1: The cookie table identifies a visitorId cookie supplied by ws.zoominfo.com, providing a visible ZoomInfo usage signal. Source: https://www.nudge-global.com/privacy-policy/
